AI_PROVIDER.PROBLEMATIC_MSG: The selected engine has technical limitations on the current server.
AI_PROVIDER.UNIQUE3D_INSTRUCTIONS:
The Unique3D engine requires the pytorch3d library, which is not supported on Apple Silicon (M1-M4) directly. This causes segmentation faults and worker crashes.

Recommended actions:
1. Use HunyuanV2 (it works locally on Mac).
2. Run the AI worker in a Docker container.
3. Use a remote Linux server with an NVIDIA GPU.
AI_PROVIDER.HUNYUAN_V1_INSTRUCTIONS: Hunyuan3D V1 is legacy. We recommend using HunyuanV2 — it's faster and produces higher quality GLB models.
